subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should this feature ship as Control UI-only work, or must native WebChat provide matching clickable tool-result URLs in the same delivery?
rationale: Current source confirms the gap in both clients, but neither the issue nor the closed unmerged PRs establishes whether cross-client parity is a release requirement; that scope determines the owner boundary and validation plan.

options.title: Require Control UI and native parity
options.body: Implement safe link rendering in both tool-card clients so users receive the same tool-result affordance across built-in chat surfaces.

options.title: Scope the first delivery to Control UI
options.body: Deliver the browser UI improvement with focused coverage and track native WebChat parity separately if it remains desired.

recommendation.title: Require Control UI and native parity
recommendation.body: Implement safe link rendering in both tool-card clients so users receive the same tool-result affordance across built-in chat surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review comment and Control UI feature history make steipete the strongest available routing candidate for the client-scope decision.
